case_title.quote: STATE OF A. P. v. M. SOHAN BABU & ANR.

number_of_accused.quote: the two accused, duly armed, had entered the premises

accused_gender.quote: A2 thereupon took out a knife from the right side of his hip pocket
accused_gender.reason: Judgment uses 'his' for A2, so male is a reasonable inference, though it is not explicitly stated for both accused.

accused_religion.reason: No religion stated for the accused.

victim_gender.quote: stabbed him on the lower part of the right arm as well
victim_gender.reason: Victims include the deceased and injured witnesses; all appear male per the text ('him'), but the sister P.W.3 Ezzard Moss is described as wife of P.W.4, so there is some ambiguity.

victim_religion.reason: Not stated; names not to be used.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The accused duly armed had entered the house of the deceased
accused_victim_relationship.reason: No prior connection described; they were intruders.

offence_category.quote: restore that of the trial court

statutory_provisions.quote: under Sections 302/34, 460 and 324 of the Indian Penal Code

weapon.quote: armed with knives which they had used repeatedly and effectively

evidence_type.quote: relying on the evidence of the aforesaid witnesses as supported by the medical evidence

aggravating_circumstances.quote: entered the premises at mid night duly armed with the intention of committing robbery

trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted and sentenced the accused under Sections 302/34, 460 and 324

high_court_outcome.quote: modified the conviction to one under Section 304 Part I IPC (while acquitting the accused of the offence under Section 302)

final_outcome.quote: restore that of the trial court

offence_finally_established.quote: set aside this part of the High Court judgment and restore that of the trial court

neutral_facts.correct_value: Remove 'a railway hospital' ambiguity is fine; but 'Other occupants... overpowered' and 'second accused ... another relative' are mostly accurate; the summary names the victim as a sportsman? No. Main issue: it says first accused stabbed relative in arm, which is correct.
neutral_facts.quote: P.Ws.1 and 2 over powered A-2 and pushed him from balcony
neutral_facts.reason: Largely accurate, but omits that A-2 was pushed from the balcony and uses 'He' pronouns for the victim; minor.

attempt_completion.quote: succumbed to his injuries on the way

physical_harm.quote: stabbed the deceased on the left side of the abdomen ... on both his thighs

number_of_offences.quote: convicted and sentenced the accused under Sections 302/34, 460 and 324

premeditation_planning.correct_value: Court noted accused entered armed at midnight intending robbery; no finding of premeditation to kill
premeditation_planning.quote: entered the premises at mid night duly armed with the intention of committing robbery

motive.quote: The initial purpose was to commit robbery

key_evidence_accepted.quote: A2 had caused one injury in the stomach of the deceased while he lay on top of him

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused were overpowered and tied up by occupants; police informed

prosecution_argument.quote: challenged by the State of Andhra Pradesh by way of this appeal
